name: HMS Harmful Brain Activity Classification
note: the paper lists CC BY-NC 4.0; the competition rules forbid redistribution; provenance (checked 2026-10-30): the data were published by the Kaggle competition 'HMS - Harmful Brain Activity Classification' (2024; Jin Jing, Zhen Lin, Chaoqi Yang, Ashley Chow, Sohier Dane, Jimeng Sun, M.
